description: Bluesky Account Posts Feed: the latest public posts and replies of one Bluesky account (a handle such as name.bsky.social, a DID or a bsky.app profile URL), reposts left out. Per post the text, likes, replies, reposts, language, media links, time and URL in the shared social schema; next_cursor pages back through the feed. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

handle.description: The account: a Bluesky handle (a domain name such as name.bsky.social, or a bare name meaning name.bsky.social), a did:plc / did:web identifier, or a bsky.app profile URL.
